topSignals.title: Doosan Fuel Cell / Reverion GmbH: first overseas Ceres-licensed SOFC stack export, $76.7M
topSignals.text: — On August 5–6, 2026, Doosan Fuel Cell announced its largest-ever overseas contract: KRW 108.7 billion (~$76.7M) to supply mid-to-low-temperature (620°C) reversible SOFC stacks to Reverion GmbH (University of Munich spin-out) for deployment in European containerised biogas power plants. Stacks will be delivered in phases through H2 2027. This marks the first overseas export of mass-produced SOFC core components from Doosan's new 50 MW factory in South Korea, using technology licensed from Ceres Power. Reverion will use the stacks in reversible SOFC/SOEC mode — generating power from biogas and optionally producing green hydrogen. Strategic significance: first commercial proof of Ceres Power's stack licensing model delivering European export volume; validates Ceres's Endura platform at production scale outside Korea; Reverion's reversible deployment is a new SOFC-data-center-adjacent use case (distributed biogas-to-power). Ceres Power (CWR.L) shares responded positively on the news. Gasworld | Hydrogen Fuel News | LSE/Ceres announcement | FuelCellsWorks

topSignals.title: ERCOT Batch Zero suspended — PUCT August 20 hearing to define audit scope for 474 GW DC queue
topSignals.text: — Following Gov. Abbott's August 3 directive, ERCOT confirmed it has suspended the Batch Zero Large Load classification notification (originally due August 7) and will seek a "good cause" exception at the PUCT's August 20 open meeting. The audit covers approximately 250–300 projects — roughly 90% data centers — drawn from ERCOT's unprecedented 474 GW of interconnection requests (5x ERCOT's record peak demand). ERCOT stated publicly that the audit could take months to complete. The August 20 PUCT hearing will establish the audit scope, timeline, and any interim interconnection rules. SOFC implication: on-site SOFC deployments that are grid-independent (behind-the-meter, not requiring ERCOT interconnection) are structurally exempt from the Batch Zero freeze. Hedgehog USA Texas (1.5 GW Bloom SOFC, ERCOT Batch Zero self-supply pathway) is directly in the frozen queue and could face delay. Market interpretation: retail investors read the Texas pause as broadly bullish for on-site SOFC bypass solutions. Watch August 20 PUCT open meeting for audit criteria and any Batch Zero exemption language. Holland & Knight | Bracewell | Akin Gump | Houston Public Media | Texas Tribune

topSignals.title: FERC RM26-4: T-1 day — August 17 tariff reform deadline arrives tomorrow
topSignals.text: — As of August 16, no conforming tariff filings from PJM, MISO, NYISO, or SPP have appeared in the FERC RM26-4 docket. Tomorrow is the hard statutory deadline: each RTO must either file revised large-load interconnection tariff language or submit a compliance response justifying the status quo. These filings will define, for the first time in formal tariff text, how co-located large-load data centers (>20 MW, >=69 kV) interact with grid costs across ~70% of US electrical load — the direct regulatory basis for the $5–20/MWh avoided-transmission-cost SOFC LCOE benefit. CAISO tracks November; ISO-NE BYOG mandate pending. Activate LCOE avoided-T-cost input once filings land August 17–18. FERC RM26-4 docket | BD Law | Akin Gump

Rolls-Royce SMR GDA Step 3: August 2026 was the scheduled completion date for the 53-month UK Generic Design Assessment (Step 3 started July 31, 2024). No Design Acceptance Confirmation (DAC) published by ONR as of August 16. A DAC issuance this month would mark the first Western SMR to clear full UK regulatory assessment and trigger construction authorisation at Wylfa. If delayed, it further widens SOFC's deployment speed advantage in European co-location markets. Watch ONR/Rolls-Royce SMR press channels. Rolls-Royce SMR progress | World Nuclear News

lcoe.text: Doosan/Reverion SOFC stack pricing proxy: The $76.7M deal covers stacks delivered through H2 2027 from Doosan's 50 MW/yr factory. No per-kW stack price disclosed publicly. Doosan deal size / Reverion plant capacity ratio: Reverion's containerised units are typically 200 kW–1 MW scale. If the deal covers ~20–30 MW of stacks (mid-range for 50 MW factory allocation), implied stack price ~$2,500–3,800/kW — consistent with the $4,000–6,000/kW total system capex (stack typically 50–60% of system cost). Treat as directional; monitor Reverion project announcements for deployed capacity figures.

ERCOT audit: Texas on-site SOFC queue risk quantification. If the PUCT August 20 ruling exempts behind-the-meter self-supply projects from the audit (as ERCOT's current Batch Zero framework implies), Hedgehog USA Phase 1 (104 MW) remains on track; if not, a months-long delay shifts the Texas SOFC pipeline risk by 1–2 quarters. Relevant for 2027 market-size scenario in LCOE model.

FERC RM26-4 — activate tomorrow: When PJM/MISO/NYISO/SPP filings land August 17–18, extract: (a) any explicit self-supply/co-located load exemption mechanism, (b) the defined cost-allocation structure for large loads that do interconnect, and (c) study timeline for large-load applications. These three items define the $5–20/MWh avoided-T-cost input range for multi-region SOFC LCOE scenarios.
